label_defs.name: Claim

moon_form.name: Claim ID
moon_form.instructions: The claim number printed in the document header, format CLM-HO-<8 digits>. Take it exactly as printed.

moon_form.name: Insurer Name
moon_form.instructions: The insurance company name in the top header, repeated in the footer of the last page.

moon_form.name: Insurer Address
moon_form.instructions: The insurer's address, directly under the company name in the top header. Not the insured property address in Section 2.

moon_form.name: Date of Submission
moon_form.instructions: The submission date in the header block. Not the incident date in Section 3.

label_defs.instructions: The claim's identity and the insurer, from the document header.

moon_form.name: Total Structure Damage
moon_form.instructions: Section 5, 'Total Structure / Dwelling Damage'.

moon_form.name: Total Personal Property
moon_form.instructions: Section 5, 'Total Personal Property Loss'.

moon_form.name: Total Additional Living Expenses
moon_form.instructions: Section 5, 'Additional Living Expenses (if displaced)'.

moon_form.name: Total Claim Amount
moon_form.instructions: Section 5, 'TOTAL CLAIMED AMOUNT' — the bold total at the foot of the table, not a per-category subtotal.

label_defs.name: Claim > Claimant
label_defs.instructions: Section 1 — who is making the claim.

moon_form.name: Name
moon_form.instructions: Section 1, 'Full Legal Name'. The person making the claim.

moon_form.name: Phone Number
moon_form.instructions: Section 1, 'Daytime Phone'. Keep the punctuation and country prefix exactly as printed.

moon_form.name: Email Address
moon_form.instructions: Section 1, 'Email Address'.

moon_form.name: Policy Number
moon_form.instructions: Section 1, 'Policy Number', format HO-<8 digits>. This is the key that links the claim to its policy — take it exactly as printed.

label_defs.name: Claim > Damage Inventory

moon_form.name: Category
moon_form.instructions: Section 4 table, 'Category' column. One occurrence per table row.

moon_form.name: Location
moon_form.instructions: Section 4 table, 'Location in Home' column, for this row.

moon_form.name: Description
moon_form.instructions: Section 4 table, 'Description of Damage' column, for this row.

moon_form.name: Estimated Cost
moon_form.instructions: Section 4 table, 'Estimated Cost' column, for this row. Keep the currency as printed — claims arrive in several currencies and are never converted.

moon_form.name: Repair or Replace
moon_form.instructions: Section 4 table, 'Repair or Replace' column, for this row.

label_defs.instructions: Section 4 — the damage table. One occurrence per row; a claim has between one and five.

label_defs.name: Claim > Incident
label_defs.instructions: Section 3 — what happened and the emergency response.

moon_form.name: Date of Incident
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, the 'Date of Incident' field only. Do NOT read a date out of the incident description.

moon_form.name: Time of Incident
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, 'Approximate Time', as printed.

moon_form.name: Type of Incident
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, printed as 'Type of Loss' — e.g. Fire, Water Damage, Storm, Theft. Take the claimant's stated type; the assessor's cause determination is a separate document.

moon_form.name: Description of Incident
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, the free-text 'Description of What Happened'. Capture the whole narrative — a later analysis compares it against the assessor's findings.

moon_form.name: Police Report Filed
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, Emergency Response, 'Was a police report filed?'

moon_form.name: Police Report Number
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, Emergency Response, 'Police Report Number'. The form prints 'N/A' when no report was filed — take it as printed.

moon_form.name: Emergency Services Called
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, Emergency Response, 'Were emergency services called?'

moon_form.name: Temporary Repairs Made
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, Emergency Response, 'Were temporary repairs made to prevent further damage?' This answers the policy's duty-to-mitigate condition.

moon_form.name: Temporary Repairs Description
moon_form.instructions: Section 3, the description of the temporary repairs. The form prints 'N/A' when none were made — take it as printed.

moon_form.name: Street Address
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'Street Address' — the insured property, including any unit or flat number. A unit number is load-bearing: it is compared against the policy.

moon_form.name: City
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'City'.

moon_form.name: State
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'State'. Legitimately blank in countries that have none — leave it empty rather than inventing one.

moon_form.name: Zip Code
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'ZIP Code'. Exactly as printed, keeping any leading zeros or letters.

moon_form.name: Primary Residence
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'Is this your primary residence?' — the Yes/No answer.

moon_form.name: Present At Incident
moon_form.instructions: Section 2, 'Were you present at the property at the time of the incident?' — the Yes/No answer.
